newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece's DEP picks advisors for 10 pct flotation.
newsitem.headline: Greece's DEP picks advisors for 10 pct flotation.

text.p: Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) picked Salomon Brothers, SBC Warburg, Ionian Finance and Ernst & Young as advisors for a planned 10 percent flotation this year and group restructuring, it said.
DEP's board approved unanimously the proposal of the evaluating committee which considered bids by nine consortia which were then screened down to three, DEP said.
